issues.title: Wild levels have no policy once the later roads open after two badges
issues.established: WB-WORLD-ORDER opens the later roads after the Thorn and Tide Badges; Wardens scale to badges held; CAP_TABLE caps a 2-badge team at 35; the historical country bands run 32 to 72.
issues.finding: After ORDER, 38 of the 46 map nodes are reachable with only Thorn and Tide and no lessons. Fixed per-country bands would put the later roads above the cap. route-encounters.md (integration 3) and PR #539 both flag it; nothing decides it.
issues.recommendation: Decide one rule before finalising tables: each encounter area stores a relative band, and the level is chosen when the encounter starts from the badges held, clamped to CAP_TABLE, the same way Wardens already scale. Areas reachable at 0 or 1 badge keep fixed low bands.
issues.owner: Evan decides; Codex applies it in the encounter proposal
affects: all ordinary areas reachable at 2 badges

issues.title: Encounter areas need a fixed denominator tied to graph ids
issues.established: The native chapter joins Larkhaven, Thornwood Trail, Millgrass Lane and the Dewcut approach in one continuous grid. Evan's rule counts encounter areas.
issues.finding: Without a fixed list, the at-least-half-originals rule cannot be checked, and grass inside one grid can blur two graph places.
issues.recommendation: An encounter area is one graph place id. Tag every grass patch, cave floor and water surface with the place id it belongs to. The denominator is the 33 places this audit classes as ordinary (including ordinary+special); at least 17 need an original. This audit marks 18 recommended areas across every country and the water. Codex may swap areas if both counts and the spread still hold.

issues.title: Orchard Fen has no rope, so Threadmeet opens two badges early in WB-WORLD-1
issues.established: WB-WORLD-1 keeps today's ropes and says Orchard Fen and Ribbon Road stay behind the later ropes so Threadmeet does not open early. Today Sunthread is behind the Echo Badge.
issues.finding: Computed on the graph with phase-1 ropes: Reedhold (4 badges) to Orchard Fen to Threadmeet reaches Threadmeet and Ribbon Road at 4 badges instead of 6. gates.md open point 4 and route-encounters.md integration 1 flag it unresolved.
issues.recommendation: Add {link: orchardfen--sunthread, badge: echo} to ropesUntilOrder (today's Hollowecho to Sunthread rope, placed at the Threadmeet end). Orchard Fen itself stays walkable from Reedhold. WB-WORLD-ORDER lifts it with the others.

issues.title: The Answering Ways has no link from Bellstep, its own mouth
issues.established: The design puts the first cave's mouth in the hamlet (not tile 19, 8). answering.json has an S exit to hollowecho. The lead ruled the edge on #373.
issues.finding: The graph has only flintcut--answering, so the cave is a dead end from Flintcut and the mouth Bellstep is promised is missing.
issues.recommendation: Adopt PR #523's ungated two-way phase-3 hollowecho--answering edge (the ruled change). The graph then has 55 links.

issues.title: Trial Road's direct way into the league before phase 6 is only a note
issues.established: The design keeps Trial Road reaching the league until Trialstair is inserted in phase 6. Today's Farwatch north exit asks for all eight badges.
issues.finding: The graph has no link for phases 1 to 5, so a validator cannot show the ending stays reachable then (gates.md open point 9).
issues.recommendation: Record a trialroad--league link (gate: all eight badges, phase 1) marked as replaced by trialstair in phase 6, or add a phase-range field the tests honour. Do not move the league door.

issues.title: Sootpath's Ember rope is assumed lifted but not named
issues.established: Today's Emberfall north exit asks for the Ember Badge. WB-WORLD-ORDER's lifted list omits it, but its done check needs Sootpath open after two badges.
issues.finding: The graph and gates file follow the done check; the design text still disagrees with itself.
issues.recommendation: Keep ember on emberfall--sootpath until WB-WORLD-ORDER, and add the Ember rope to that phase's lifted list when the design is next edited.

issues.title: Most arrival landings are unknown and must stay unknown until each grid is measured
issues.established: Six phase-0 links have verified 2D landings. Knothollow, the Answering Ways and Larkburrow briefs keep landings null with landing: planned.
issues.finding: See the per-link landing status counts in region-audit.md. The native chapter's grid uses different coordinates, so legacy tiles are not native landings.
issues.recommendation: Resolve each landing when its place is drafted with location-template.md, on the runtime that will use it, and keep the runtime-landing validators rejecting nulls at wiring. The per-link status is recorded here; none is filled in.

issues.title: The first expedition is an out-and-back with no destination yet and no loop until Grove Wake
issues.established: The native chapter plays Maren's catch, inn and return. Deeper Thornwood and Dewcut have closed boundaries. In the graph, Rootwater and Dewcut are spurs until the Thorn Badge and Grove Wake join them through Knothollow.
issues.finding: Larkhaven to Thornwood Trail and back is a sound first outing, but Thornwood (the town) is not built in the chapter, so there is no Warden, healer or arrival moment at the far end. The first loop (Trail, Dewcut, Old Root Grove, Knothollow, Rootwater, Thornwood) needs the Thorn Badge and Grove Wake (bond 60), so it may come late.
issues.recommendation: Next, build Thornwood (the town) as the destination: Isolde at the hawthorn gate and the Gate Loft healer together, so the outing ends with a rest and a goal. Keep the return home on the same trail (the classic first-route shape) and keep the visible future access: Larkburrow's shut mouth, the Dewcut shelf, Rootwater's cave door. Treat the Knothollow ring as the first loop and confirm Grove Wake's timing (RA-09).

issues.title: Grove Wake's teaching badge is inferred, and it sets when the first loop opens
issues.established: The grove teaches Grove Wake at the antler sign; the design gives no badge. gates.json records thorn as inferred.
issues.finding: If Grove Wake is later than Thorn, the Knothollow ring opens later still.
issues.recommendation: Confirm Thorn (keeps the early loop early) or record the intended badge.

issues.title: Thornwood's healer is a proposal; the first destination has no rest yet
issues.established: Hedda and the Gate Loft are proposed for phase 1. Old Ned's inn exists.
issues.finding: The three-step healer rule holds early only if Hedda exists; Old Root Grove is already at three steps.
issues.recommendation: Ship the Gate Loft healer with the first Thornwood town build (RA-08). The other proposed keepers follow their town phases.

issues.title: Today's region screens become towns but hold most of today's grass and the Legends' first meetings
issues.established: Eight current maps become towns (31 to 113 tall-grass tiles each), and Saltmarsh Coast keeps 72. Legends' first meetings fire on explores counted by country (biome id), not map (main.gd explored_in).
issues.finding: Creature-game towns usually have no grass; removing it is safe only if the same country's routes keep counting explores.
issues.recommendation: Towns get no ordinary encounters in new layouts. Each new route keeps its parent country's biome id, so explore-driven first meetings still fire. Check each Legend threshold stays reachable. Old saves on removed grass use hard rule 1's nudge.
issues.owner: Codex (encounter data) and the map builder

issues.title: The Long Boards is a dead end although the Dry Boards are inside it
issues.established: The design places the Dry Boards inside the Long Boards maps. The graph links dryboards to stillreed and passfoot, never to longboards.
issues.finding: longboards has one link (Reedhold). The data hides that the Dry Boards are reached through it.
issues.recommendation: Record longboards as the Dry Boards' parent (a field or note), or describe the Reedhold to Dry Boards link as the Long Boards' west end, following PR #523's descriptor. No new route.

issues.title: Greymill is named but has no node
issues.established: Greymill is a side door off Threadmeet with a Hush stuck door; gates.json places it as a spot on sunthread.
issues.finding: Encounter and finds work could treat it as a missing map.
issues.recommendation: Keep it a Threadmeet sub-area, not a node. Class it as no encounters until Evan approves Greysail.

issues.title: Keelcave is in the prose and graph but not the flowchart
issues.established: The caves list puts Keelcave off Greywash Sound; the graph marks greywash--keelcave extraToFlowchart.
issues.finding: The design text disagrees with itself.
issues.recommendation: The prose and graph stand. Add Keelcave to the flowchart the next time the design doc is edited.

issues.title: errands.json treats Lantern Quay and Outer Shoal as unassigned places
issues.established: The graph assigns lanternquay and outershoal.
issues.finding: Tobin's errand is anchored on saltmarsh_route with a named place although the ids exist.
issues.recommendation: Use the graph ids in errands.json when it is next revised.

issues.title: Optional lesson chains are long without a town
issues.established: With every lesson, the longest town-free walk is six routes (world-graph.md question 5); every place stays within three steps of a healer.
issues.finding: Old Root Grove and Outer Shoal sit at three steps, the limit.
issues.recommendation: Accept: nothing forces the long walk. Revisit only if playtests show tired teams on the Coast Ring.

issues.title: Existing wild lists are historical, original-only tables
issues.established: route-encounters.json (WBW-5), knothollow.json and answering.json copy the legacy BIOMES lists of original species.
issues.finding: Evan's current direction makes Pokémon the main reusable roster with originals in at least half the areas.
issues.recommendation: Label those wild lists historical. Use their level bands only as evidence. Codex's proposal supersedes them.

issues.title: Glassfall appears both as a place and as a link
issues.established: The graph stores glassfall in places with isLink and in links.
issues.finding: Counting places without skipping isLink gives 47.
issues.recommendation: Keep it. Consumers skip isLink; this audit counts it once, as the link.

issues.title: Chart Road's loop is one link but needs two High Watch landings
issues.established: farwatch--chartroad has loop: true.
issues.finding: One record cannot carry the out and back arrival tiles.
issues.recommendation: At wiring, give Chart Road two exits into the High Watch and record both landings.

issues.title: Use the graph's names for Thornwood the town and Thornwood Trail
issues.established: The graph separates thornwood_route (Thornwood Trail) and thornwood (the town).
issues.finding: Chapter notes say 'deeper Thornwood' for both.
issues.recommendation: Name the place id in tickets and reports.
